configurations.name: page-preview
runtimeArgs: const h=require('http'),f=require('fs'),p=require('path');const D='C:/Users/ANTHON~1/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--Users-Anthony-Martinez-Downloads-kailenflow-suite/2ad6ea1d-e9e6-4edb-8be4-78057f78fdad/scratchpad';const T={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css','.js':'text/javascript','.webp':'image/webp','.png':'image/png','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.woff2':'font/woff2'};h.createServer((q,s)=>{let u=decodeURIComponent(q.url.split('?')[0]);if(u==='/')u='/preview.html';const fp=p.join(D,u);f.readFile(fp,(e,d)=>{if(e){s.writeHead(404,{'content-type':'text/plain'});return s.end('not found: '+u)}s.writeHead(200,{'content-type':T[p.extname(fp).toLowerCase()]||'application/octet-stream'});s.end(d)})}).listen(4173,()=>console.log('page-preview listening on http://localhost:4173'))
